author: Matthew Gilliam
message:
fix(security): resolve 3 critical + 3 high findings from 2026-06-11 review

Critical:
- rate_limit: ip_key now keys on the transport peer address
  (HttpServer.peer_addr, new tcp_peer_addr builtin) instead of trusting
  X-Forwarded-For; new ip_key_forwarded(conn, trusted_proxies) walks the
  XFF chain right-to-left skipping trusted hops for proxy deployments.
- session: Set-Cookie now includes Secure when MARCH_ENV=prod
  (Config.is_prod), per specs/cookies.md.
- crypto: derive_key is now HKDF-SHA256 (RFC 5869, new lib/hkdf.march on
  the Bytes-domain hmac_sha256_bytes builtin) with versioned salt
  bastion.hkdf.v1; replaces sha256(secret ++ ":" ++ context). Verified
  against RFC test vector A.1 in interp and native. NOTE: derived keys
  change — existing signed/encrypted cookies are invalidated on deploy.

High:
- static: percent-decode (Uri.decode) BEFORE the traversal check so
  %2e%2e cannot bypass the .. rejection; NUL bytes rejected; encoded
  filenames now serve correctly.
- error_overlay: /_bastion/debug/ plug and rich error page hard-gated on
  Bastion.Dev.dev_env() at runtime (404 / generic 500 otherwise).
- auth: remember-me re-auth now clears and rewrites the session
  (fixation rotation, fresh session cookie) instead of bare Session.put.

Toolchain: march d07356d (tcp_peer_addr, hmac_sha256_bytes builtins),
c69d877 (fix int tagging in C-built generic list cells).

Security review: specs/reviews/2026-06-11-security-review.md (items 1-6).

author: Matthew Gilliam
message:
fix: resolve all typecheck/lint errors — forge check, build, lint green (80 files)

Bastion-side fixes (march compiler fixes b07172f..63dcfbf were also required):

- lib/auth.march: removed legacy 46-line duplicate `mod Auth` (2-arg log_in,
  String ids); renamed auth_middleware.march -> auth.march so `import Auth`
  resolves to the real module (3-arg log_in with remember-me support)
- lib/test_conn.march: rewritten against the real HttpServer.Conn API
  (13-field ctor, Header values); the fictional HttpServer.test_conn /
  String.upcase / String.chars APIs never existed; 3-arg build_conn renamed
  build_conn_with_body (multi-head fns must share arity); authenticate_as
  dropped with TODO (needs public Session signing API)
- lib/test_channel.march: full module paths in type annotations (alias works
  at value level only), curried fn-type annotations, Option compares via match
- lib/test_auth.march: HttpServer.get_resp_header (Conn has no accessor),
  Auth.log_in/3 with None remember token
- lib/cmd.march: qualify recursive map call (Bastion.Cmd.map) — bare name
  resolved against prelude map
- lib/forge/build_islands.march: Option compares in test block via match
- lib/forge/console.march: drop dead start_app/server_port
- test/: bastion_test (TypedMiddleware.unwrap, was resolving prelude unwrap),
  test_form (build_conn via Bastion.Test.Conn, full-arity component calls,
  zero-arg lambdas), test_gate (import Gate, Option compare helpers),
  test_html_css (IOList.concat never existed — fold over append)
- test/test_islands_dataflow.march parked as .bak: march native emission
  drops the module while emitting its closure wrappers (link failure) —
  compiler bug tracked with repro
- test/test_form.march 'required marker' test: known native failure
  (nested default-arg dispatcher drops Bool arg — repro in march repo
  test/native/default_args_nested.march)
- specs/reviews/: security review + production-readiness review (2026-06-11)

forge check: 80/80 clean. forge build: green. forge lint --strict: clean.
forge test: compiles and runs; 25/26 pass in first binary (1 known native
codegen failure above blocks the remaining files until fixed).

author: Matthew Gilliam
message:
fix: rewrite crypto.march, fix forge console --server hang and cleanup

crypto.march (complete rewrite)
- Drop the fragile `alias Crypto as StdCrypto` pattern that caused a
  Heisenbug (bindings were only populated when a debug printf was present)
- Call stdlib builtins directly (stdlib_random_bytes, stdlib_sha256,
  stdlib_hmac_sha256, stdlib_base64_encode, stdlib_base64_decode) and copy
  the private helper functions inline (bytes_to_hex, hex_nibble, etc.)
- Use stdlib_hmac_sha256 instead of hmac_sha256 in the wrapper body to
  avoid infinite recursion through the name-shadowing closure
- Fix generate_token: call bytes_to_string before stdlib_base64_encode
  since the type checker models that function as String → String
- Add Err(_) catch-all arms to hmac_sha256, hash_password, verify_password
  to resolve non-exhaustive pattern warnings

forge/console.march (--server mode)
- Replace FIFO with a plain log file: opening a FIFO write-end without a
  reader blocks on macOS (open O_WRONLY stalls until a reader appears), and
  the background job inherits the TCL pipe's write-fd, so TCL's `exec` never
  received EOF — causing a permanent hang on `forge bastion.console --server`
- Capture the server PID via `set server_pid [exec sh -c "... & echo $!"]`
  so the server is killed when the user exits the REPL (`:q` or Ctrl+C)
- Print log file path and tail hint at startup

logger.march
- Remove explicit `: Logger.Level` return type annotation from parse_level;
  inside mod Bastion.Logger the annotation resolved to bare `Level` while
  the body returned `Logger.Level`, causing a spurious type error

registry.march
- Fix `Some(string_to_int(s))` → `string_to_int(s)`: string_to_int already
  returns Option(Int), so wrapping it in Some produced Option(Option(Int))
